- One-Time product for Course A has Availability Set In Order = True
- today = 2026-08-10; product_start_date = 2026-08-10; product_end_date = 2026-12-31
steps_actions:

title: Lesson Allocation – Create Order – Same Course with Different Classes and Durations – Each LA Uses Its Matching Class

- Student A has active enrollment at Location 1 and a payment method
- Course A has Require Allocation = True; Class A and Class B both belong to Course A
- Slot-Based product for Course A has Availability Set In Order = True
- today = 2026-08-10; duration_a = 2026-08-10 to 2026-09-30; duration_b = 2026-10-01 to 2026-12-31
steps_actions:
1. "Create a New Order Group for Location 1"
2. "Add Slot-Based Course A with Class A and duration A"
3. "Add Slot-Based Course A with Class B and duration B"
4. "Submit the order"
5. "Open the Course A LAs and Class Member records"
steps_result:
1. "A new Order Group is available"
2. "The first row shows Course A, Class A, and duration A"
3. "The second row shows Course A, Class B, and duration B without replacing the first row"
4. "The order is submitted without an error"
5. "Two distinct LAs exist: duration A links to Class A and duration B links to Class B"
